Used Firstbase, it's cheaper and took me 2 weeks to get up and running. Supports Stripe, sets up US bank account with mercury.io (need passport). Watch out: must file tax reports even with zero sales (hired Fiverr for $48); annual Wyoming report each June costs $209 (anonymous) or $111 (public).

Last time I checked, Stripe Atlas was probably the only 'all in one' service available to help starting a C-Corp. Now there seem to be several similar services including Firstbase, Capbase, and Angellist Stack, with similar pricing - asking which is best and what to watch out for.

Purchased a $399 package from Firstbase.io, requested cancellation immediately after realizing it was a mistake. Took a month to process cancellation with no refund issued; Firstbase cited ToS saying refunds aren't possible once formation process is complete or a government agency is reviewing documents.
